recognize_zh: 胸水細胞離心抹片中央有一小團5顆緊密相貼、核互相擠壓（molding）的小圓細胞，核質比高、細胞質極少，與周圍散在的巨噬細胞明顯不同；這種小圓藍細胞團塊符合轉移性神經母細胞瘤（neuroblastoma）。
features: Tight cohesive cluster of about five small round tumor cells with nuclear molding
High N:C ratio with scant, pale to basophilic cytoplasm
Round nuclei with finely granular chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved
Scattered larger reactive macrophages/mesothelial cells with abundant frothy cytoplasm around the cluster
Paucicellular background; low magnification limits cytologic detail and no neuropil or rosettes are seen
describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of pleural fluid shows a paucicellular background of scattered macrophages and mesothelial cells. In the center there is a tight cohesive cluster of small round cells with high N:C ratios, scant cytoplasm, and nuclear molding, distinct from the background reactive cells. Rosettes or fibrillary neuropil are not identified, and the low magnification limits assessment of chromatin and nucleoli. In a child with a known adrenal/paraspinal mass, findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma; confirmation by immunocytochemistry (PHOX2B, synaptophysin) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are discohesive single cells without molding and are TdT/CD3 or CD19 positive rather than PHOX2B positive.
Mesothelial cells have more abundant dense cytoplasm, windows between cells, and calretinin positivity.

ddx.dx: Other small round blue cell tumors (Ewing sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Separated by immunostains such as CD99/NKX2.2 for Ewing and myogenin/desmin for rhabdomyosarcoma.
Occurs in adults with similar molding but is keratin positive and PHOX2B negative.
